title: Save a churning customer
summary: When a customer requests cancellation, execute a save flow with usage data and discount offer.

parts.title: Pull customer usage data
parts.guidance: Compare the customer's recent and earlier activity over a defined period using the correct account identifiers. Look at actions tied to their intended outcome, active users and unresolved support issues. Label instrumentation gaps separately from inactivity. Build a short account timeline with links to the observations and questions for the customer about their reasons for leaving.

parts.title: Check CRM health score
parts.guidance: Inspect the CRM health score's components, update time and owner. Compare it with recent conversations, renewal context, support history and usage. Correct factual errors and flag unexplained scoring results, separating evidenced risks and customer statements from the account team's interpretation.

parts.title: Prepare save offer
parts.guidance: Match the customer's stated problem to a specific remedy, such as onboarding help, a fix or a plan change. Specify its delivery owner, limits, cost and contract effect. Resolve any feature commitment or discount outside the account team's authority before presenting the offer.

parts.title: Send retention email
parts.guidance: Send the retention message to the confirmed customer contact within the account team's communication authority. Acknowledge their specific concern, describe the agreed remedy and its limits, and give them a clear way to respond. Use verified account facts and commercial terms. Add the sent message and next follow-up to the CRM so another teammate can continue the conversation accurately.

parts.title: Schedule call
parts.guidance: Offer call times with a timezone and an agenda based on the customer's concern. Include the people who can resolve it and send the invitation through the account team's agreed process. Record the accepted slot and preparation notes; an offered time remains tentative until the customer agrees.

parts.title: Apply discount or cancel
parts.guidance: Apply the customer's chosen outcome to the correct subscription and effective date. Check a concession's amount, duration and renewal effect, or a cancellation's access consequences and outstanding charges; treat any refund as a separate decision. Preview the exact change where supported and resolve anything outside billing authority. Apply it once, then read back the subscription and invoice state before confirming completion to the customer.

parts.title: Log outcome in CRM
parts.guidance: Update the CRM with the customer's stated reason, decision, agreed remedy and verified billing or support result. Link the relevant conversation. Distinguish promised work from delivered work and an accepted offer from resumed use, then assign any remaining follow-up.

metadata.supportReason: Stripe/HubSpot APIs provide data. Email automatable. Actual save conversation is person-routed.
